Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47 Sees Saturday Growth in Box Office Performance

Box Office Update

The Telugu film *Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47* (AK 47) has reported a total worldwide collection of Rs 33.95 crore following its first two days of release. Directed by Trivikram Srinivas and starring Venkatesh Daggubati, Srinidhi Shetty, and Nara Rohith, the film experienced a rise in audience turnout on its second day in theaters.

Performance Highlights

According to industry reports, the film's financial performance shows a positive trend moving into the opening weekend:

  • Domestic Growth: The film recorded a 6.7% increase in net earnings on Saturday, October 31, compared to its Friday opening, collecting Rs 10.40 crore across 3,192 shows.
  • Occupancy Trends: Overall occupancy across India improved from 44.1% on Friday to 48.1% on Saturday, with night screenings recording the highest attendance at 68.23%.
  • Regional Contributions: The states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana remained the primary drivers, accounting for 79.9% of the domestic gross on Saturday.
  • International Reach: Overseas markets have contributed a cumulative Rs 10.35 crore to the film's total worldwide gross.

Budget Context

While the movie has seen a growth in attendance, reports suggest it faces a significant path toward commercial recovery. With a reported production and promotional budget of Rs 128 crore, the film's current worldwide gross remains substantially behind its total cost. Based on these initial figures, the production would need to increase its current worldwide returns by more than four times to reach a break-even point relative to its estimated budget.

About the Film

*Aadarsha Kutumbam House No: 47* centers on the story of characters Chittibabu and Swarna. The plot explores the complexities of their household at House No. 47 as hidden family secrets begin to emerge. The film also features a supporting cast including Nivetha Pethuraj, Vennela Kishore, Satya Akkala, Rao Ramesh, and Brahmaji.

Verification of Data

Box office figures are preliminary and based on data provided by tracking services like Sacnilk and industry reports. These totals are subject to change as official studio records are finalized and updated.
